# Event Map

Every `event.Kind` the run loop and its extensions can emit, in source
declaration order with the source doc comment. A Kind missing from this table
fails `make verify-catalog`, so a new event cannot be silently
undocumented. Producers and consumers live in the packages named in each
comment; the controller/sinks documented in `internal/event/event.go`
consume the stream as a whole.

| Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|
| TurnStarted | marks the start of one top-level Run (one user turn). Sinks reset any per-turn rendering state on it. Carries no payload. |
| Reasoning | is a thinking-mode reasoning delta (Text). Streamed before the visible answer; sinks typically render it muted under a "thinking" header. |
| Text | is an answer-text delta (Text). |
| Message | marks the assistant turn's text as complete: Text holds the full answer and Reasoning the full chain-of-thought (both already streamed via the deltas above). A sink may use it to re-render the streamed raw text as styled markdown; a plain sink can ignore it. |
| ToolDispatch | announces a tool call is about to run (Tool: ID/Name/Args/ReadOnly). |
| ToolResult | reports a finished tool call (Tool: Output/Err/Truncated set). |
| Usage | carries per-turn token telemetry (Usage; Pricing optional, for cost). |
| Notice | is an out-of-band message — a warning, truncation, block, or compaction notice (Level + Text). |
| Phase | marks a coordinator boundary, e.g. planner→executor handoff (Text = label such as "deepseek · planning"). |
| ApprovalRequest | asks the frontend to approve a pending tool call (Approval: ID/Tool/Subject). The run blocks until the controller's Approve(ID, …) resolves it; a frontend shows a prompt and answers. |
| AskRequest | asks the frontend to put one or more structured multiple-choice questions to the user (Ask: ID + Questions). The run blocks until the controller's AnswerQuestion(ID, …) resolves it. Powers the `ask` tool. |
| TurnDone | marks the end of one top-level Run (Err non-nil on failure; nil also for a user cancellation, which is not an error). Always the last event of a turn. |
| CompactionStarted | marks the start of a context-compaction pass (Compaction payload: Trigger). A frontend shows a "compacting…" placeholder while the summarizer runs; CompactionDone replaces it. Mirrors ToolDispatch/ToolResult. |
| CompactionDone | reports a finished compaction pass (Compaction payload: Trigger/Messages/Summary/Archive). An aborted pass emits this with an empty Summary so the placeholder still resolves. Replaces the older plain Notice so a sink can render a distinct, expandable card. |
| ToolProgress | streams a chunk of a still-running tool's combined output (Tool: ID + Output = the new chunk). Emitted between ToolDispatch and ToolResult for long tools like bash so a frontend can show live progress. Appended last to keep the Kind values before it wire-stable. |
| MCPSurfaceReady | used to fire when a server's background-loaded surface (prompts or resources) finished after startup; no producer emits it since the batch-start flow was replaced by lazy connect. The slot is kept so the Kind values after it stay wire-stable for serialized events. |
| Retrying | fires before each backoff sleep while the provider re-attempts the connection+header phase after a transient failure (RetryAttempt of RetryMax). A frontend shows a transient "retrying (n/m)" indicator that the next stream event — or TurnDone — clears. Appended last to keep the Kind values before it wire-stable. |
| Steer | fires when a mid-turn steer message is consumed from the queue and injected as a user message. Text carries the raw steer content (without the wrapper prefix), so a frontend can display it to the user as confirmation. Frontends use Steer to know a queued message has been delivered. |
| GuardianAssessment | reports the outcome of a guardian sub-agent safety review. Carries GuardianResult payload (Outcome, RiskLevel, Rationale, etc.). |
| KindCount | is a sentinel one past the last real Kind. New event kinds must be inserted above it so completeness tests cover them automatically. |
